mechanism: Nafcillin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP1A2 inducer that increases flecainide metabolism, reducing flecainide plasma concentrations and potentially decreasing antiarrhythmic efficacy.
action: Monitor flecainide levels and ECG parameters closely; may require flecainide dose adjustment upward if nafcillin is initiated or dose reduction if nafcillin is discontinued.
